hooks.command: mkdir -p "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude"; sid=$(jq -r '.session_id // "unknown"'); { echo; echo "## Сесія: $(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') <!-- session-id: $sid -->"; echo; } >> "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/prompts.md" || true
prompt=$(jq -r '.prompt // empty'); [ -n "$prompt" ] && { echo "### $(date '+%H:%M:%S')"; echo; echo "$prompt" | sed 's/^/> /'; echo; } >> "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/prompts.md" || true

sid=$(jq -r '.session_id // empty'); log="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/prompts.md"; [ -f "$log" ] && [ -n "$sid" ] && content=$(awk -v sid="$sid" 'index($0, "<!-- session-id: " sid " -->") { found=1; sub(/ <!-- session-id:.*-->/, "") } found { print }' "$log") && [ -n "$content" ] && jq -Rs '{systemMessage: .}' <<< "$content" || true

data=$(jq -r '(.tool_input.file_path // "") + " " + (.tool_input.path // "") + " " + (.tool_input.pattern // "")'); case "$data" in *.env*) echo "Access denied: .env files are protected by a security hook" >&2; exit 2 ;; esac
